prompt: Create an original 120 second melodic chiptune instrumental composition for coding, deep work and analytical tasks. Mood: focused, steady, precise. Instruments: pulse-wave lead, triangle bass, noise percussion. Style: clear arpeggiated game-like melody and concise rhythmic phrases. Tempo approximately 136 BPM; A minor. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Keep a stable repeating texture with very few distracting fills. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:40] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:40-01:20] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:20-02:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:00.

description.en: A high-energy electronic track featuring a catchy, chiptune-like melody over a driving synth bass and rhythmic drums. The arrangement evolves with various synth layers, creating an upbeat and retro video game atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首充满活力的电子音乐，以一段朗朗上口的芯片音乐风格旋律为主，配以强劲的合成器贝斯和富有节奏感的鼓点。编曲中融入了多种合成器音色，营造出欢快且复古的电子游戏氛围。
